newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian average lending rate down to 8.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Croatian average lending rate down to 8.7 percent.

text.p: The Croatioan average lending rate dropped 50 basis points to 8.7 percent on Tuesday on low demand for fresh kuna funds.
Total settlements reached 20.4 million kuna, 12.7 million of which accounted for fresh borrowings, mostly made at a call money rate of 9 percent.

Dealers said one smaller long-term placement was made at 20 percent. There was no overnight trade as no banks reported sfortfalls. The central bank calculated its kuna midrate for Wednesday slightly firmer at 5.3992 against the dollar and 3.5697 against the German mark.-- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
